title: Test-Time Scaling for CAD Generation via Verifier-Free Consensus Selection
abstract: arXiv:2608.09706v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models can write parametric CAD programs from a natural-language description (text-to-CAD generation), but a single sample is often wrong. Increasing test-time compute by sampling multiple candidates only helps if a good candidate can be identified, yet no ground-truth model is available at generation time. Existing systems often require a separate verifier, such as a vision-language judge, to select among candidates. We investigate whether the candidate pool itself provides enough signal for effective selection and a verifier-free alternative. We introduce 3D CAD consensus selection, hereafter consensus selection: sample $N$ parametric CAD programs, compile them to 3D models, and return the candidate that agrees most with the rest of the pool. translated_title: 无验证器共识选择实现CAD生成的测试时扩展
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.09706v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：大型语言模型可以从自然语言描述中编写参数化CAD程序（文本到CAD生成），但单个样本通常是错误的。通过采样多个候选来增加测试时计算量，只有在能够识别出好的候选时才有效，而在生成时没有可用的真实模型。现有系统通常需要单独的验证器，例如视觉-语言评判器，来在候选中进行选择。我们研究候选池本身是否提供了足够的信号用于有效选择，以及是否存在无需验证器的替代方案。我们引入了3D CAD共识选择，以下简称共识选择：采样$N$个参数化CAD程序，将它们编译为3D模型，并返回与池中其余候选最一致的候选。该方法无需训练，且与现有CAD代理兼容。我们研究了几何和拓扑上的一致概念，每个概念都改进了其对应的性能。
tldr: 我们提出了一种无验证器的共识选择方法，通过采样多个CAD程序并选择与其余候选最一致的编译3D模型，无需额外验证器即可提升文本到CAD生成的测试时性能。
en_tdlr: We propose a verifier-free consensus selection method that samples multiple CAD programs and selects the compiled 3D model most consistent with the rest, improving test-time performance for text-to-CAD generation without extra verifiers.
